news.title: Greek Containership Sunk by Naval Drones Off Bulgaria as Black Sea Attacks Escalate
news.summary: A Greek container ship has sunk after being hit by naval drones off Bulgaria on Wednesday, the Bulgarian government said, in the latest of a series of strikes in the western Black Sea this month that have raised concerns about the widening scope of Russia's war in Ukraine.

news.title: QatarEnergy Continues LNG Buying Spree to Hedge Future Hormuz Disruptions
news.summary: QatarEnergy is buying long-term supplies of liquefied natural gas from the US and other producers as part of a trading strategy designed to generate revenue if exports through the Strait of Hormuz are disrupted in the future, CEO Saad Sherida Al-Kaabi told Reuters on Thursday.

news.title: Taiwan Flags ‘Obvious’ Threat From 50 Chinese Vessels in Wide Sweep of Waters
